title: Sun Meaning
overview: The Sun describes core identity, vitality, creative force, visibility, and the part of the chart that wants to live with purpose. It shows what gives a person energy, what they are learning to embody, and where life asks them to act from the center rather than from imitation or approval-seeking.
cycle: The Sun moves through the zodiac once each year, spending about one month in each sign. Its sign describes the style of identity and vitality; its house shows the life area where that identity seeks expression.

signs.body: Sun in Aries expresses identity through courage, immediacy, initiative, and the willingness to begin. This placement needs movement, challenge, and room to act directly.
Sun in Taurus expresses identity through steadiness, embodiment, loyalty, and the building of lasting value. This placement needs stability, beauty, and a life that can be trusted by the senses.
Sun in Gemini expresses identity through curiosity, language, movement, and connection. This placement needs variety, conversation, learning, and room to keep asking better questions.
Sun in Cancer expresses identity through care, protection, memory, and emotional intelligence. This placement needs belonging, privacy, and a life rooted in what feels safe and meaningful.
Sun in Leo expresses identity through creativity, warmth, visibility, and personal radiance. This placement needs joy, self-expression, and permission to be seen without performing for approval.

Sun in Virgo expresses identity through discernment, craft, service, repair, and attention to what can be improved. This placement needs useful work and a way to serve without reducing the self to flaws.
Sun in Libra expresses identity through relationship, balance, beauty, fairness, and social awareness. This placement needs reciprocity and the courage to choose without disappearing into compromise.

Sun in Scorpio expresses identity through depth, emotional honesty, trust, and transformation. This placement needs real intimacy, privacy, and the strength to release control when truth is asking to surface.
Sun in Sagittarius expresses identity through meaning, movement, candor, learning, and the search for a wider horizon. This placement needs freedom, truth, and experience that becomes wisdom.
Sun in Capricorn expresses identity through discipline, responsibility, structure, and earned authority. This placement needs goals that matter and a path where effort can become legacy.

Sun in Aquarius expresses identity through originality, perspective, community, and future-minded change. This placement needs room to be different while staying connected to something larger than the self.

Sun in Pisces expresses identity through empathy, imagination, spiritual sensitivity, and porous awareness. This placement needs compassion, creative space, and boundaries strong enough to protect openness.
